Name: Simple More Items Fishing Treasure
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]🎣 Simple More Items Fishing Treasure[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]This mod is made for PC. Android compatibility has not been tested.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#D8B4FE]Requested by [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Harold45]Harold45[/url][/b].[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Add configurable extra loot to successfully recovered fishing treasure chests while keeping the original treasure.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]🌟 Golden Chests — New in 1.2[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Successfully recovered golden fishing chests receive a separate rare bonus, [b]enabled by default with one rare roll and one unit[/b]. Adjust the minimum and maximum to [b]1–20 rare rolls[/b] and [b]1–50 units per roll[/b]. Items may repeat; native stack limits still apply, so non-stackable equipment stays at one per roll.

This bonus is independent of the ordinary bonus chance and optional random rare-loot switch. [b]Categories, exclusions and mine progression still apply.[/b] If your settings leave no eligible rare item, the original treasure remains and the mod logs a warning instead of granting excluded loot.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53870/53870-1792202592-1985852046.png[/img]
Version 1.2 golden-chest settings — isolated native render, not live gameplay.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🎣 Ordinary Bonus Treasure[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Defaults to a [b]20% chance[/b] for [b]1–3 bonus selections[/b], with [b]1–3 units per selection[/b]. Set separate minimum/maximum chances, selections and quantities; ordinary selection and quantity ranges support 1–100. Matching minimum and maximum values give a fixed setting.

Resources, bait and tackle, seeds and forage, and minerals are enabled by default. Ten additional categories start Off: [b]artisan goods, animal products, artifacts, cooking, craftable items, ingredients, monster loot, special items, weapons and wearable items[/b]. Eligible pools use category weights, rebalanced when a category is empty. Supported registered modded ordinary items can join eligible categories; arbitrary custom equipment is not automatically included.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#D8B4FE][b]💎 Optional Random Rare Loot[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Optional random rare loot starts [b]Off[/b]. When enabled, its default [b]5% chance[/b] is checked once after the ordinary bonus chance succeeds, replacing at most one ordinary selection with one rare item. Adjust this chance from 1–50%.

The curated rare pool includes progression-gated valuables and selected weapons, rings, boots, a hat and clothing. Enabling a category does not bypass its mine gates or exclusions. Optional ordinary light and magnet rings are a separate setting and start Off.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#A7F3D0][b]⚙ Choose What Can Drop[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to adjust rewards and categories, or edit the generated config.json while the game is closed. Excluded item IDs override loot settings; use raw object IDs or qualified IDs such as (O)72. Equipment exclusions use their qualified IDs. Settings are available in twelve languages.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]📦 Requirements & Use[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b] and compatible [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.x[/url]. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional. Extract the [b]SimpleFishingTreasure[/b] folder into Mods and launch through SMAPI.

This mod does not increase chest appearance chances, automate fishing or reward lost chests. Native overflow pages handle large rewards; automation may require manual collection and retains its own full-inventory/discard behaviour.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#D8B4FE][b]🧪 Testing & Current Limits[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Recovered-treasure rewards, golden-chest bonuses, repeat protection, native stack limits and overflow have passed isolated native checks, including SSE 1.27 and Auto Fishing 1.1 reward hooks. [b]Live gameplay, copied-save and full-modpack confirmation are still pending.[/b] Multiplayer, split-screen and physical-controller play have not been verified. Translations are AI-assisted and have not been proofread by native speakers.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Please share reports and ideas on this mod’s page. For bugs, include the mod version, game/SMAPI versions and platform, what happened versus what you expected, steps to reproduce, relevant loot settings and fishing mods, and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]shared SMAPI log[/url]. A screenshot or short video can help.

For suggestions, explain what you would like changed or added and how it would improve the mod.[/color][/size][/center]
